title: BEFORE LAB 1 — HOUR 1 QUICK CHECKS
instructions: Poll first, reveal answer second, ask a student to justify third.

questions.question: Which statement best describes machine learning?

options.A: Writing explicit if/else rules for every input
options.B: Systems improving at a task by learning patterns from data
options.C: Storing and querying very large databases
options.D: A technique that removes the need for data

questions.correct_answer: Systems improving at a task by learning patterns from data
questions.explanation: ML learns from data rather than hand-coded rules. Choice A is traditional programming.

questions.question: Grouping customers by behavior with NO predefined categories is…
questions.explanation: No labels means unsupervised. Clustering discovers structure without a known target.

questions.question: Which stage consumes the MOST time in real ML projects?
questions.explanation: Data preparation typically takes 60–80% of project time.

questions.question: Which workflow best protects the integrity of final evaluation?

options.A: Scale the full dataset, then split into train and test
options.B: Split raw data first; fit preprocessing on training data; tune with validation/CV; evaluate on test once
options.C: Use the test set repeatedly while selecting hyperparameters
options.D: Train on validation and test data after every failed experiment

questions.correct_answer: Split raw data first; fit preprocessing on training data; tune with validation/CV; evaluate on test once
questions.explanation: Split first, fit preprocessing only on training data, tune with validation/CV, and touch the test set once.

questions.question: Why is fitting StandardScaler on the entire dataset before train/test splitting a problem?

options.B: The training transformation uses information from the test set

questions.correct_answer: The training transformation uses information from the test set
questions.explanation: The scaler learns means and standard deviations from test data — that is leakage.

questions.question: Why is `stratify=y` often useful in binary classification splits?

options.A: It guarantees identical feature means in both splits
options.C: It preserves approximately the same class proportions in each split
options.D: It guarantees there is no data leakage

questions.correct_answer: It preserves approximately the same class proportions in each split
questions.explanation: Stratification keeps the positive/negative ratio approximately equal across splits.

questions.question: In scikit-learn, which method trains an estimator?
questions.explanation: .fit() learns model parameters from training data.

questions.question: What is the most important benefit of using a scikit-learn Pipeline?

options.A: It guarantees the highest possible model accuracy
options.B: It fits preprocessing using training data within each training/CV fold and applies it consistently to held-out data
options.C: It eliminates the need for train/test splits
options.D: It automatically chooses the best algorithm

questions.correct_answer: It fits preprocessing using training data within each training/CV fold and applies it consistently to held-out data
questions.explanation: Pipelines prevent leakage by fitting preprocessing only on the training portion.
